challenge.method: Under pinned SCES-1.0 §§3–4 and Protocol stage 7, I checked both boundaries of the section against the Apache appendix, third-party terms and legacy LLVM license. I tested whether either paragraph could support a general attribution waiver or unconditional GPLv2 compatibility.
challenge.results: The heading follows the Apache appendix, and the third-party heading follows the second paragraph. The first paragraph enumerates three subsections, omitting §4(c). The second requires both a qualifying combination and a court determination. The legacy University of Illinois/NCSA license appears under its own later heading.

limitations: The first paragraph concerns redistribution of portions embedded in Object form through compilation and enumerates §§4(a), 4(b) and 4(d).

The second concerns compiled forms combined or linked with GPLv2 software. It conditions the choice to exclude whole conflicting sections on a determination by a court of competent jurisdiction and limits that choice to the Combined Software.
Coverage of a particular file, release or combination and any separate base-edition relationship require their own evidence.
